items.q1: How fast can my order ship?
items.a1: Most products ship within 5 business days after artwork approval. Stickers ship in 3 days.
items.q2: Do you support corporate volume discounts?
items.a2: Yes — submit an RFQ for orders of 50+ units and our sales team will reply within one business day.
items.q3: Can I bring my own design files?
items.a3: Absolutely. Upload PNG, SVG, AI or PDF directly in the customizer or attach them to an RFQ.
